summary_en: 8,831,200 shares (3.93% of shares outstanding) to be cancelled. Effective 2026-08-31. Post-cancellation issued shares: 216,111,904.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Tokai Carbon's board of directors resolved on 2026-08-24 to cancel 8,831,200 treasury shares (3.93% of shares outstanding) effective 2026-08-31, pursuant to the Companies Act Article 178. Post-cancellation, the company's issued shares will total 216,111,904 shares.
